regions.today: Mostly cloudy this afternoon and evening, with pathy light rain or drizzle, in light northeasterly or variable wind.
regions.tonight: Mostly cloudy with patchy rain or drizzle for a time in northern areas and more general rain far north later. Widespread mist and fog will form in near calm conditions and the fog will become dense in places. Lowest temperatures of 3 to 7 degrees, coldest in the south where most clear spells are expected.
regions.tomorrow: Widespread mist and fog at first tomorrow with poor visibility, clearing from most areas through the morning but possibly lingering in some places as winds remain very light. Cloud and the odd patch of drizzle will affect northern areas but it'll be drier elsewhere with just an isolated shower and sunny spells developing through the day. A cooler day with highest temperatures of 7 to 11 degrees.
